text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking around the<n>academy after
class has let out...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello there, Trainer. Good<n>afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm on my way to the cafeteria for a<n>costume party.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to do something from a<n>fantasy world, so I
decided to dress<n>up as a cleric.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Grass, you look wonderful! It<n>suits you so
well!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Hehe, thank you. I'm glad<n>that I could do
this costume justice.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text:
And being a cleric with healing<n>powers is just
perfect for you, too!
choice_data_list: You do have that calming vibe about you.
You do have that calming vibe about you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, I'm honored...

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I don't just mean her vibe.<n>There was this
one time, back when<n>we first enrolled...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Oh, this is no good... Nomatter how hard I train, I keep fallingbehind...

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text: The standards at Tracen really are<n>crazy high...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text:
You're right... It's like there's no<n>point in even
trying anymore.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! You're gonna do more,<n>Grass?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But you just finished healing from<n>your last injury.
I know tryouts are<n>coming up, but if you push
yourself<n>too hard...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'm doing the rest of<n>today's training
in the pool, to avoid<n>straining my body too much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have to do everything I possibly can.<n>I don't want
to have any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I tread too gingerly around minor<n>setbacks, I will
never achieve the<n>growth I desire.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Okay! Then I won't lose,<n>either! Time t'get
serious!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. ♪ Why don't you join me for<n>that swim,
then?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we're about to lose heart...<n>we
remember those words and press<n>on!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman with Braids
text_block_list.text:
Your magical words of courage<n>healed us, in a way.
You gave us the<n>courage we lost!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I gave you... courage?
choice_data_list: Now that does sound like your kind of magic.
Now that does sound like your kind of magic.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
While I'm grateful to my fans for their<n>support... I
always run purely for my<n>own sake.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I never thought my efforts would<n>inspire someone
else.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I suppose a cleric's healing magic<n>can come in
many forms.
choice_data_list: You'll have to run your best to inspire the rest.
You should use your magic on me next time.
You should use your magic on me next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I suppose a cleric's healing magic<n>can come in
many forms.
choice_data_list: You'll have to run your best to inspire the rest.
You should use your magic on me next time.
You should use your magic on me next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In fact, the thought is raising my<n>spirits already.
It makes me want to<n>start running at once.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As luck would have it, the party<n>won't start for a
little while yet. A<n>quick run shouldn't pose a
problem.

text_block_list.name: Underclassmen
text_block_list.text:
U-um! May we join you? We promise<n>we won't
get in the way!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course. Just to be clear, I won't be<n>holding back.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's stride is more<n>powerful than ever
after making this<n>new discovery.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No problem at all. Let's see... does it<n>go like this?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Swoosh! ♪ I cast Heal!

text_block_list.name: Underclassmen
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Us, too, please!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Dear me. Then I'll cast magic on all of<n>you at once...
Nature's Blessing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I watch Grass Wonder cast her<n>magic, just
seeing the smile on her<n>face is uplifting on its own.
